integrity: Two independent complete state-space algorithms were replayed on all 8 local tie-policy subsets; all 16,384 trajectories were covered in each algorithm. Program inputs and complete integer certificates are embedded. No independent expert audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite eleven-vertex result; neither arbitrary-graph generalization nor human historical-priority determination is asserted. The previously available incumbent-tie census is cited only as the control case. Earlier possible day-level sources for the graph diagram were not verified.
title: Local tie favoritism suppresses consensus on the Herschel graph
